arguments.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean start, but it's quite minimal right now — it only shows your email addresses. I'd suggest adding a short bio, a photo, and maybe some info about your interests or work to make it feel more personal and engaging. Also, consider listing just one primary contact email to avoid confusion. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). I love that you share your passion for hiking — that's a great topic with lots of potential. Right now the site is very brief, so I'd suggest adding posts about your favorite trails, photos from your hikes, tips for beginners, and maybe a section about gear. More content and visuals would really bring your blog to life. Happy hiking!
